title: Popcorn and Churro Vendor
content: Last night I painted a popcorn vendor in Montréal using gouache—mostly transparently.I knew the light would rapidly change as dusk settled, so I tried to anticipate where it was headed, and pick an ideal moment when the scene was saturated in cool twilight, with the popcorn and churro box lights rising in contrast.I'm here for theSyn Studio "Gathering of Masters,"a group-taught workshop on concept art.(Link to YouTube)Gumroad Tutorial:Gouache in the Wild
